blocks.text: Perfective form of archaic Russian каза́ть, from Proto-Slavic *kazati.

head: Word
Part of speech
Made of (Wiktionary's etymology)
Meaning (Wiktionary)
rows: to tell; to relate, to narrate
(literary genre) tale; fairy tale; lies, fabrication
to express (oneself), to say, to tell, to pronounce
to affect; to manifest itself in, to show
